title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) will play Sunday
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay confirmed that Puka Nacua will play on Sunday against the Eagles.
items.impact: Barshop notes that "the Rams are still working through how they will navigate Nacua's snap count." It will still be tough to sit him in fantasy lineups.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Parkinson was unable to practice all week. He'll likely be on the wrong side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Ferguson will be sidelined as expected after leaving last Sunday's game early. Colby Parkinson will be questionable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Donald (back) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Donald has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Donald was unable to practice all week. The Rams defensive line takes another hit against Jalen Hurts and the Eagles.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) has been ruled out for the Minnesota Vikings against the Miami Dolphins Sunday according to Tom Pelissero.
items.impact: Jefferson will not suit up after struggling to take the practice field all week for head coach Kevin O'Connell, with Jordan Addison in line for a sizeable target share against the Dolphins Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: DJ Moore is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Moore is officially good to go. He'll be a WR2 for fantasy managers against a Patriots defense without Christian Gonzalez.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Legette has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Legette will miss a second straight game. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Branch (Achilles) 'close' to returning
items.desc: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said Brian Branch is "close" to returning to the field.
items.impact: Branch is continuing to work his way back from a torn Achilles. The Lions haven't opened his 21-day window for return, but it seems like that could happen soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Warren Brinson (groin) to miss a 'significant amount of time'
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Warren Brinson will miss "a significant amount of time."
items.impact: Brinson has been dealing with a calf injury. He is likely headed for the IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ray Davis (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ray Davis is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Davis remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Sanders (illness) listed doubtful Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Sanders is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Sanders is likely to be sidelined due to an illness.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) 'should be good to go' Sunday
items.desc: Bills head coach Joe Brady said Keon Coleman "should be good to go" for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Coleman was limited in practice on Thursday. He remains a volatile WR4/WR5 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Benford (toe) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Christian Benford is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Benford did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Overshown isn't quite yet ready to return, but he appears to be getting closer.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Yaya Diaby (calf/shoulder) good to go Sunday
items.desc: Yaya Diaby is good to go for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Diaby returned to practice on Thursday. He is officially good to go for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) good to go Sunday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter is good to go for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Trotter is good to go despite dealing with a shoulder injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ko Kieft (elbow) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Ko Kieft has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Kieft remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Benjamin Morrison (quad) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Morrison was downgraded after he got in a limited practice on Thursday. The depth in the Bucs secondary will take a hit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Bain was absent from practice all week. The Bucs defensive line will take a hit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.impact: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Hendrickson had a procedure on his finger. He is week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) absent from practice Friday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley was not seen practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Stanley was limited in practice on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored on the injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Cross (illness) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Nick Cross has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Cross did not practice all week. He'll be sidelined for Sunday's game in London.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Rachaad White has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: White was unable to practice all week. Jacory Croskey-Merritt should handle a bigger role in the Commanders backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Terry McLaurin is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: McLaurin was a late addition to their injury report after he was limited in practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff Sunday morning.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Michael Schmitz Jr. (personal) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: John Michael Schmitz Jr. was not at practice Friday, but he is expected to play on Sunday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Michael Schmitz was away from the team on Friday due to personal reasons. He is expected to be available on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) back at practice Friday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Thomas made his return after he was absent on Thursday. It is a positive sign for his availability heading into the weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Barmore (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Christian Barmore has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Barmore has been ruled out as expected after missing practice all week. It is a big loss for the Patriots defense against Josh Allen and James Cook.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Gonzalez has been ruled out as expected after missing practice all week. It is a big loss for the Patriots defense against Josh Allen and the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zack Baun (concussion) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Zack Baun remained absent from practice on Friday.
items.impact: Baun remains in concussion protocol. He will likely be ruled out when the injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Friday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith remained absent from practice on Friday.
items.impact: Smith will likely be ruled out when the official injury report is released later in the afternoon. Dontayvion Wicks and Makai Lemon will figure to step into bigger roles in his place.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Young (knee) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Bryce Young is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Young received a precautionary MRI at the start of the week. He has been able to practice in full and is officially good to go for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving (glute) good to go Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving is officially good to go for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Irving sat on the bench for the majority of the fourth quarter last week. He was limited in practice throughout the week and will be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: This was the expectation as Mayfield is expected to miss the next few weeks. It will be rookie QB Jalon Daniels starting in his place.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mason Graham (MCL sprain) to miss a few weeks
items.desc: Mason Graham is expected to miss a few weeks with an MCL sprain.
items.impact: Graham also suffered an ankle sprain in Thursday's win over the Steelers. It is a positive sign he was able to avoid a major injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Coker is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Coker remained limited in practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored heading into kickoff Sunday night, but he appears to be on the favorable side of questionable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D'Andre Swift (knee) expected to practice Friday
items.desc: D'Andre Swift is expected to return to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Swift was added to the injury report after not practicing on Thursday. Bears coach Ben Johnson said he is optimistic on Swift playing on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Williams has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Williams will officially miss a second straight game. Bears head coach Ben Johnson won't name a QB starter on Friday between Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) back at practice Friday
items.desc: Reggie Gilliam returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Gilliam will still need to be monitored on the injury report when it is released this afternoon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) back at practice Friday
items.desc: Morgan Moses returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Moses will still need to be monitored on the injury report when it is released this afternoon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) practices Friday
items.desc: Nico Collins was at practice again on Friday.
items.impact: Collins was limited on back-to-back days to start the week. He continues to trend towards making his return on Sunday.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) out for Week 4
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (ankle) will not play in Week 4.
items.impact: Douglas will miss a second straight game due to an ankle injury. The trio of Malik Washington, Chris Bell, and Kevin Coleman Jr. will lead the way among the Dolphins' wide receivers.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (foot) should be "good to go," according to Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley on Friday.
items.impact: Wright practiced in full on Thursday and is expected to be on the field Sunday. With De'Von Achane (knee) done for the season, the Dolphins need all the RB depth they can get. After missing Week 3, Wright should share the load with Ollie Gordon.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) will not play in Week 4
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Mitchell will miss a second straight week due to his finger injury. Sterling Shepard and Malik McClain should see increased snaps again in Mitchell's absence.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) will miss Sunday's game
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) will not play in Sunday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Taylor has not practiced this week and will miss a second straight game. Rookie TE Kenyon Sadiq should continue to see his role grow.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) will not play Sunday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) ruled out for Week 4.
items.impact: Hall has not been practicing this week and, as expected, will not play Sunday. Braelon Allen should be the workhorse back for the Jets in a matchup with the Bears.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Aaron Rodgers turns in another big passing performance
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 40 passes for 299 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
items.impact: For the second straight week, Rodgers tossed three touchdowns while coming up just short of 300 yards. This time, however, it was not enough for a win. Rodgers threw multiple interceptions for the first time this season on Thursday night, and that helped the Browns build a 14-point lead. Rodgers did bring the Steelers back, leading two TD drives in the fourth quarter, but the Steelers' defense couldn't stop the Browns' game-winning drive. Rodgers has gotten into a groove with his receivers the last two games, and an attractive matchup with the Colts awaits in Week 5.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jaylen Warren gains 126 yards of offense Thursday night
items.desc: Jaylen Warren rushed for 93 yards on 17 carries and caught 3-of-6 targets for 33 yards in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
items.impact: With backfield mate Rico Dowdle (toe) sidelined again, Warren took advantage of a workhorse load for the second straight game. He has yet to find the end zone this season, but Warren is averaging an elite 5.6 yards per carry while gaining over 300 yards on the ground through four games. He has also hauled in 13 of 19 targets for better than 35 yards per game. Warren is locked in as an RB2, especially in PPR formats.
